attribution.adverse_selection_markout_note: Unidentified: pooled forward markouts do not isolate adverse selection or form an additive P&L decomposition. legacy_pooled_markout_proxy retains the former numeric expression for compatibility only; use the separate per-horizon observed-quantity diagnostics.
attribution.note: Attribution is an analytical approximation; inventory mark-to-market is the reconciliation residual.

execution_quality.markout_aggregation_note: Quantity-weighted summaries are separate gross observed fill-to-future-midpoint diagnostics for each horizon, with both supplied per-unit outcomes finite. They include entry spread, are not net P&L, and do not isolate adverse drift. Missing quantity is not extrapolated; no observations gives null amounts/means. Coverage can differ by horizon. Legacy horizon means are event-row means; legacy side means pool horizon rows, including duplicate requests.
